# Introduction

This project explores sentiment patterns in Pride and Prejudice by Jane Austen using sentiment analysis in R.

# Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidytext)
library(janeaustenr)
```

# Load Text





```{r}
book <- austen_books() %>%
  filter(book == "Pride & Prejudice")
```
# Tokenization

```{r}
tidy_book <- book %>%
  unnest_tokens(word, text)
```

# Sentiment Analysis

```{r}
sentiment_data <- tidy_book %>%
  inner_join(get_sentiments("bing"))
```

# Count Sentiment

```{r}
sentiment_counts <- sentiment_data %>%
  count(sentiment)
```

# Visualisation

```{r}
ggplot(sentiment_counts,
       aes(x = sentiment, y = n)) +
  geom_col()
```
